subject: Customer vignette request — availability & quick data checklist
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Customer vignette request — availability & quick data checklist

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for being willing to participate in a short customer vignette for Gartner. We keep these tight (20–30 minutes) and focus on the business outcome and engineering wins — nothing technical that would require code-level review.

Two asks from our side to move this along:
1) Can you confirm 20–30 minute windows next week (Mon/Wed/Thu preferred)?
2) Please review the attached consent form and the brief questionnaire — the questionnaire is just five topline items we often publish as a 1‑page vignette (we’ll also share a draft quote for approval).

Attachments: case_vignette_consent.pdf (PDF, 42KB); vignette-questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)

If you prefer, Ben Turner from Gartner asked for a short call and we can run this as the same conversation — that avoids duplication. I’ve copied Marissa (customer advocacy) and Karthik (solutions) to help coordinate.

Proposed next steps: I’ll book a 30-minute slot once you confirm availability, then we’ll circulate a one‑paragraph draft and the short quote for sign‑off.

Thanks,

Sean Gallagher
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Hi Sean —

Happy to help. Wed (9/15) 11:00–11:30 PT or Thu (9/16) 14:00–14:30 PT work for me. Prefer Wed if Ben can make it.

Quick note on the questionnaire: I can answer the business/outcome questions but I’ll need Karthik to confirm a performance stat (p50 latency reduction number) — I’ve cc’d him here. The consent form looks fine; I’ll sign once the draft quote looks accurate.

—Olivia

olivia.park@heliohealth.com | +1 206-555-0921

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the options. I can be on the Wed 9/15 11:00 PT slot. Re the p50 latency number: our monitoring shows a median inference latency reduction of ~42% after switching HelioHealth to the deduped KV cache profile we shipped in March. I’ll bring the dashboard screenshot to the call and Sean/Marissa, I can add the chart to the one‑page if that number is okay to use.

I’ll also prepare the short engineer-friendly blurb for the call so we don’t get into implementation weeds — high level is ideal for Gartner.

Karthik
